gloss: to plan; to scheme; to project

definitions.gloss: to plan; to make a plan; to project; to design
definitions.explanation: To formulate a detailed method or strategy for achieving something. Used for both personal plans and large-scale projects.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}を{計画|けいかく}する。
{来年|らいねん}の{予算|よさん}を{計画|けいかく}している。
examples.english: We are planning next year's budget.

examples.japanese: {市|し}は{新|あたら}しい{公園|こうえん}の{建設|けんせつ}を{計画|けいかく}しているが、{住民|じゅうみん}の{意見|いけん}が{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: The city is planning the construction of a new park, but residents' opinions are divided.

notes:
A する verb composed of {計|けい} (measure, calculate) + {画|かく} (plan, scheme). One of the most common する verbs for expressing planned actions and projects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てる: to make a plan (using the noun form)
- {計画|けいかく}{通|どお}り: as planned
- {計画|けいかく}{的|てき}に: in a planned manner, systematically
- {計画|けいかく}を{実行|じっこう}する: to carry out a plan
- {計画|けいかく}が{頓挫|とんざ}する: for a plan to fall through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {企画|きかく}する: to plan, to organize — emphasizes creative planning for events, products, or projects
- {予定|よてい}する: to schedule, to plan — focuses on when something will happen rather than the detailed strategy
- {策定|さくてい}する: to formulate (a plan/policy) — more formal; used for official policy-making
- {立案|りつあん}する: to draft a plan — emphasizes the drafting stage of plan creation
